title: 16 personality profiles
subtitle: Your everyday preferences
description: Twenty short situations can help you notice which ways of connecting, deciding, and planning tend to feel more natural.
algorithm: There are no right answers. Choose the option that usually feels closer to you.
Answer from habit, not from what you think you should do. Preferences may shift with context.
comment: This is an informal, unvalidated reflection quiz, not the official MBTI assessment or a diagnosis. Treat the result as a prompt, not a label.
